description: TypeBox authoring sources and their equivalent portable JSON definitions. The typebox field holds TypeScript source. The definition field names one file in definitions/valid that holds the equivalent artifact. A wrapper converts the source with the documented conversion in contracts/v0/input-schema.md, validates it, and compares the canonical content and the definition-domain hash with the canonical and content_hash fields. Both sides must agree exactly.

pairs.note: The authoring field version becomes schema_version. The description annotation is removed. The minLength constraint stays. The definition omits when_uncertain, so the canonical form materializes review.
An ordered scale keeps its array order through authoring, conversion, and canonicalization.
pairs.canonical: {"checks":[{"accept":{"at_least":"meaningful"},"id":"consequence","name":"The concern warrants an interruption","question":"What consequence does this concern have, based on the evidence?","scale":[{"minor":"A wording or preference difference with no identified operational consequence."},{"meaningful":"A coordination problem causing rework or delay."},{"serious":"A conflict affecting an explicit customer commitment or operational requirement."}],"using":["prior_decision","conversation","proposed_message"]}],"inputs":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"conversation":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"prior_decision":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"proposed_message":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}},"required":["prior_decision","conversation","proposed_message"],"type":"object"},"name":"consequence-level","schema_version":1,"when_uncertain":"review"}

pairs.note: Numeric bounds, arrays, booleans, and a nested object with its own required list convert without loss. The optional modifier removes area from the nested required list. The conversion adds no keyword and removes no constraint.
pairs.canonical: {"checks":[{"accept":"yes","answers":{"no":"The notes do not name the owning team.","yes":"The notes name the owning team."},"id":"notes-complete","name":"The release notes identify the owning team","question":"Do the notes name the team that owns the change?","using":["summary","metadata"]},{"id":"summary-free-of-todos","name":"The summary carries no open work marker","rule":{"excludes":"TODO"},"using":["summary"]}],"inputs":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"breaking":{"type":"boolean"},"confidence":{"maximum":1,"minimum":0,"type":"number"},"metadata":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"area":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"team":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}},"required":["team"],"type":"object"},"severity":{"maximum":5,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"summary":{"maxLength":200,"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"tickets":{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"maxItems":50,"minItems":1,"type":"array"}},"required":["summary","severity","confidence","breaking","tickets","metadata"],"type":"object"},"name":"release-notes-review","schema_version":1,"when_uncertain":"review"}
